findings.title: Current Source16 installer emits Source15 retry2 terminal results
findings.body: The current proof.kind and admitted source/candidate refer to Source16, but the success branch emits PASS_SOURCE_V15_RETRY2_COLD_LOCAL_INSTALL_WITH_COPY_COMPATIBILITY, both failure branches emit FAIL_SOURCE_V15_RETRY2_* and the final stable-metadata success predicate compares the same old15 PASS literal. A successful current install would therefore serialize a mixed-version receipt, and a correctly typed Source16 consumer would reject it or be forced to accept an old15 result for new16. Port all four current output/predicate sites in a new immutable successor. Preserve the exact accepted15 historical(proof) assertion and historical receipts unchanged.

required_before_private_C: Six role-specific actual audits and exact proof/source-review/raw-audit chains
Current actual install inputs fullref, final manifest/PINNED/release refs and fresh Installer/Cold source reviews
Root Ready guard for six detailed native gates plus direct accepted15 ancestry before any current private inspection
Root_invocation_contract.termination: Retained verified process HANDLE with PID/createTime/image/argv/listeners; graceful shutdown and descendant drain remain NOT_PROVEN
Root_invocation_contract.copies: Exactly three exclusive fresh direct DATA siblings, full bytes/ADS/ACL/timestamps compared
Root_invocation_contract.data_integrity: No DATA restore; only inventoried ordinary top-level sqlite-shm modified/LastWriteTime may differ in named live phases, all other bytes/streams/metadata/order exact
Root_invocation_contract.rollback: EXE-only exact accepted15 bytes, never DATA restore

qualification: Retained hard throws and missing final pins prevent admission. Concrete stale terminal-result finding requires immutable successor; all actual install/Ready/private operations remain NOT_PROVEN. No target import/call, DB/PE/private input read/hash or runtime action by reviewer.
